svg.title: Budget thresholds and where their alerts go
svg.desc: The budget lab-az104-04-cost-monthly, 5 a month on rg-lab-az104-04-cost from the 1st, has three thresholds: 50% and 80% of actual spend and 100% of forecast spend. Each one alerts the action group lab-az104-04-cost-budget-alerts, which has no receivers yet, so nothing is sent until you add one.
